title: Add step-synthesizer and contract-preview playground for typed tool authoring
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Engineers authoring RAG agents and tool contracts often iterate between schema changes, example steps, and end-to-end smoke tests. This PR introduces a compact, local-first playground that 1) previews typed tool contracts (JSON Schema + human-readable contract view), 2) synthesizes step templates from a contract (CLI + UI), and 3) provides a tiny devserver and VS Code snippet pack so authors can iterate without needing the full dev stack. The goal is to reduce authoring feedback loops and contract drift between examples, docs, and runtime stubs. What this PR adds: - a new example workspace at redwood-examples/step-synthesizer-playground with multiple sample tool contracts and canonical step templates - a CLI binary scripts/rw-synth that generates step skeletons from contract metadata and can emit VS Code snippets and inline test harnesses - a lightweight devserver (playground/server.js) that renders a contract-preview UI, allows one-click synthesis of example steps, and validates structured-output roundtrips against the contract schema - VS Code extension snippets at redwood-examples/.vscode/snippets/step-synth.code-snippets and a README authoring guide at redwood-examples/step-synthesizer/README.md - unit smoke tests that run the synth pipeline and validate the generated snippets against a small lint rule set (tests/synth.test.js) Usage examples: - Synthesize into an examples folder: ./scripts/rw-synth synth --input examples/contracts/payment.json --out examples/steps/payment --format vscode - Run devserver: cd redwood-examples/step-synthesizer-playground && node server.js && open http://localhost:3002 - VS Code: install snippets by copying .vscode/snippets/step-synth.code-snippets into your workspace and trigger with prefix "rwd-step" Checklist: - [x] Contract preview UI for JSON Schema + human summary - [x] CLI synth commands and --dry-run - [x] VS Code snippet generator - [x] Smoke tests and CI jobs - [x] Docs/README with quickstart and troubleshooting Notes on design decisions: - The contract preview intentionally renders a simplified human summary (field descriptions, required/optional, example values) instead of a full JSON Schema editor to keep the surface area small for the initial release. - The synth CLI emits conservative step skeletons (comments and minimal I/O scaffolding) so generated code is safe to paste and iterate on. - We intentionally avoid adding runtime dependencies on the redwood core runtime; this stays fully in examples to keep the onboarding friction low. Related work: Links to internal Linear items: ENG-1423 (authoring feedback loop), PM-98 (docs quickstart uplift). Also references to the authoring UX spike in ENG-1399. CI notes: initial CI run failed due to a flaky snapshot in synth.test.js; fixed by normalizing timestamps in generated snippets. Merge strategy: squash. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes to runtime APIs; this is examples-only and docs-facing.
commits: feat(synth): add rw-synth CLI with synth and validate commands
feat(ui): add contract-preview devserver and summary renderer
chore(docs): add README, VS Code snippets, and quickstart examples

release_notes: Adds an examples-first authoring playground for tool contracts and step synthesis. Includes rw-synth CLI, a contract-preview devserver, VS Code snippets, and smoke tests. This is docs/examples only and does not change runtime behavior.
